IncidentTriageBuildStep.description:
The fully-captured reference workflow built on 2026-06-17.

This one is modelled separately from the catalog because it is a different kind of artefact: it branches three ways off a Classify node, where every catalog workflow is linear. It is the only capture set in the repository that shows a multi-branch Coral workflow assembled action by action.
